source: NCERT Class VI, Curiosity: Textbook of Science, Ch. 3.

sections.heading: 1. Food and its Components
points: Food contains **nutrients**: **carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins, minerals**, plus **water** and **dietary fibre (roughage)**.
**Roughage** (fibre) is not digested but helps in **egestion** (removal of waste); **water** helps digestion and controls body temperature.

sections.heading: 2. Sources of Nutrients
points: **Carbohydrates:** rice, wheat, potato, sugar.
**Fats:** ghee, butter, oil, nuts.
**Proteins:** pulses (dal), beans, milk, eggs, fish, meat, paneer.
**Vitamins & minerals:** fruits and vegetables.
**Millets (Shree Anna)** — e.g. ragi, jowar, bajra — are nutritious traditional grains.

sections.heading: 3. Balanced Diet
points: A **balanced diet** contains all nutrients in the **right amounts**, plus roughage and water.
**Mindful eating** = eating the right amount, not too much or too little; over-eating causes obesity.
Needs vary with age, activity and health.

sections.heading: 4. Deficiency Diseases
points: **Vitamin A** deficiency → **night blindness**.
**Vitamin B1** deficiency → **beriberi**.
**Vitamin C** deficiency → **scurvy** (bleeding gums).
**Vitamin D** deficiency → **rickets** (weak/bent bones).
**Iron** deficiency → **anaemia**.
**Iodine** deficiency → **goitre**.
**Calcium** deficiency → weak bones and teeth.

sections.heading: 5. Tests for Nutrients
points: **Starch (carbohydrate):** add **iodine solution** → turns **blue-black**.
**Protein:** add copper sulphate + caustic soda solution → turns **violet**.
**Fat:** rub on paper → leaves a **translucent oily (grease) spot**.

sections.heading: 6. High-Yield One-Liners (Last-Minute Recall)
points: Nutrients: carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins, minerals (+ water, roughage).
Energy = carbs & fats; body-building = proteins; protective = vitamins & minerals.
Starch + iodine → blue-black; protein test → violet; fat → oily spot on paper.
Scurvy = vit C; rickets = vit D; night blindness = vit A; beriberi = vit B1.
Anaemia = iron; goitre = iodine; roughage aids removal of waste.
Millets = Shree Anna (ragi, jowar, bajra).

sections.heading: 7. Common Traps (Watch Out)
points: **Iodine test detects STARCH** (blue-black), not protein.
**Scurvy = Vitamin C**, **rickets = Vitamin D** — don't swap.
**Goitre = iodine** deficiency; **anaemia = iron** deficiency.
**Roughage/fibre gives no nutrient** but is essential for removing waste.
